about: Stone and both stromatolites on a REAL Gleba surface (game.planets.gleba.create_surface(), derived seed) with gleba_plants, gleba_enemy_base and gleba_cliff at size 0 and cliff richness 0, no data-stage mod; one request_to_generate_chunks radius request covering the window and 2 chunks of margin, then force_generate_chunk_requests. Each entity is [name index, x * 256, y * 256], its exact position in 1/256 tile, listed when floor(position) is in the window or the one-tile ring around it (a stromatolite box reaches one tile past its own); counts and census are the window alone. autoplacers and tiles are read from the prototypes at runtime; fields are calculate_tile_properties at positions, as f32 hex bits. Written by scripts/probes/gleba-entities/capture.ts.
